transcript:
User: Welcome to Boardwalk Beer Garden. My name is Lana. Let me know if you need to speak to management and would like to be transferred. What's your name, and how can I help you? 
Agent: Hey Lana, quick question — what time does your kitchen close tonight? I'm trying to coordinate a group and one person gets off work pretty late, so I want to make sure we don't miss the food cutoff. Also, is the kitchen close time different from the bar close time on Thursdays?
User: Great questions. Our kitchen closes at midnight every night, including Thursdays. The bar stays open until one AM, so you'll still have an extra hour for drinks after the kitchen stops serving food. If you're planning for a group, let me know if you wanna book a table. I can send you our reservation link right now. 
Agent: Perfect, that helps a lot! Just to double-check — if we get there at, say, 11:30pm tonight, can we still order a full meal, or is there a limited late-night menu? And is midnight a firm cutoff, or do you stop taking food orders a little earlier if the kitchen gets busy?

Also, is it the same hours on weekends, or does the kitchen or bar close later on Fridays and Saturdays?
User: You can order from the full menu right up until midnight. There's no limited late night menu. Midnight is the firm cutoff for kitchen orders. So as long as you place your order before then, you're good to go even if it's busy. The hours are the same on weekends too. Kitchen closes at midnight, and the bar stays open until one AM on Fridays and Saturdays. If you wanna lock in a table for your group, just let me know. 
Agent: Awesome, thanks for clarifying! That really helps with planning. A couple more quick things:

- Is last call for drinks exactly at 1am, or do you do a last call announcement a little before then?
- Is it 21+ only after a certain hour, or can people under 21 stay the whole night?
- What’s the crowd usually like late on a Thursday compared to Friday or Saturday? Trying to get a sense if it’s packed or more chill.
- And just in case we want to come back for brunch or lunch — what time do you open on weekends?

Thanks for all the info, Lana!
User: Thank you so much for all the info. See you soon.
